title: Office-to-cloud hybrid network

expected_evidence_facts.fact: The cloud VPC has CIDR 10.40.0.0/16 and contains a private subnet.
An office customer gateway is configured with BGP ASN 65010.
An IPsec VPN connects the office customer gateway to a VPN gateway attached to the VPC.

critical_unresolved_decisions.question: Which prefixes are advertised in each direction, and is propagation automatic or static?
critical_unresolved_decisions.why_it_matters: No route tables or propagation resources are present.

critical_unresolved_decisions.question: Is one logical VPN sufficient, or must the diagram show redundant customer-side devices and failover?
critical_unresolved_decisions.why_it_matters: Customer-side redundancy is not represented in Terraform.

critical_unresolved_decisions.question: How should names resolve across the office and cloud boundary?
critical_unresolved_decisions.why_it_matters: The configuration contains no hybrid DNS components.

critical_unresolved_decisions.question: Where are traffic inspection and firewall policy enforced?
critical_unresolved_decisions.why_it_matters: The VPN alone does not establish a security-control boundary.

forbidden_unsupported_assumptions: Direct Connect or another private circuit
